---
title: "quarto-shapes"
subtitle: "CSS shape classes for Quarto documents and presentations"
---

Style divs as shapes that can contain text and other elements. Supports fill, stroke, rotation, and sizing — all composable as classes.

## Installation

```bash
quarto add emilhvitfeldt/quarto-shapes
```

## Quick Start

Add to your YAML front matter:

```yaml
---
title: My Document
format: html
filters:
  - shapes
---
```

Then wrap any content in a shape div:

```markdown
::: {.shape-circle .shape-fill-blue}
Hello
:::
```

## Modifier classes

Every shape accepts modifier classes. They are fully composable — stack any combination on a single div, in any order:

```markdown
::: {.shape-hexagon .shape-fill-none .shape-stroke-red .shape-stroke-lg .shape-rotate-90 .shape-md}
:::
```

### Fill — `.shape-fill-*`

Sets the interior color. Use `.shape-fill-none` for an outline-only shape (pair it with a stroke).

| Class | Result |
|-------|--------|
| `.shape-fill-blue` `.shape-fill-green` `.shape-fill-red` `.shape-fill-orange` `.shape-fill-purple` `.shape-fill-yellow` | Named colors |
| `.shape-fill-black` `.shape-fill-white` | Neutrals |
| `.shape-fill-none` | Transparent interior |

### Stroke — `.shape-stroke-*`

Two independent axes: outline **color** and outline **width**. Combine one of each.

| Color | Width | Default width |
|-------|-------|---------------|
| `.shape-stroke-{blue,green,red,orange,purple,yellow,black,white}`, or `.shape-stroke-none` | `.shape-stroke-sm` (1) · `.shape-stroke-md` (3) · `.shape-stroke-lg` (6) · `.shape-stroke-xl` (10) | `3` when a stroke color is set without a width class |

### Size — `.shape-{sm,md,lg,full}`

Sets the shape's bounding box. Defaults to `8rem` (same as `.shape-md`) when no size class is given.

| Class | HTML size | Typst (print) |
|-------|-----------|---------------|
| `.shape-sm` | `4rem` | `3cm` |
| `.shape-md` | `8rem` | `5cm` |
| `.shape-lg` | `14rem` | `8cm` |
| `.shape-full` | `100%` of container | — |

### Rotation — `.shape-rotate-*`

Rotates the shape clockwise in 45° steps: `.shape-rotate-45`, `.shape-rotate-90`, `.shape-rotate-135`, `.shape-rotate-180`, `.shape-rotate-225`, `.shape-rotate-270`, `.shape-rotate-315`.

See the [HTML example](examples/basic.html) for these modifiers applied across the full shape catalog.

## Typst / PDF output

Shapes also render in Quarto's `typst` format (PDF).
The existing SVG definitions are embedded as Typst images, so every shape is available.
Note these print-specific behaviors.

- Size classes map to print lengths: `.shape-sm` 3cm, `.shape-md` 5cm, `.shape-lg` 8cm.
- Content is centered within the shape's bounding box, not its visual outline.
